purpose: Conversational ED copilot / chat: summarize, explain, retrieve-grounded draft, classify intents with tools under human confirmation.
prohibitedUses: Computing validated medical scores instead of deterministic calculators
Training or fine-tuning on production PHI without BAA and legal approval
trainingDataLineage: Provider-managed foundation model (Anthropic). CareDroid does not fine-tune this model on production data. Prompt/tool configuration is CareDroid-owned.

benchmarkResults.note: Offline safety suite is fixture-based; live LLM candidate scoring not yet required for CI.

limitations: Default AI_PROVIDER=anthropic; multi-provider adapters exist but tool/stream parity varies.
PHI minimize is pattern-based, not full de-identification.
Requires human review on all clinical outputs (provenance contract).
retirementPlan: Rotate to next approved model via registry entry + canary; never silent swap. Keep local adapter as deterministic degraded mode.
